$comment: This repository owns no content of its own: every file under skills/ is a copy of one in Nerviz, and this file says which, from where, and at what ref. The copy exists because a plugin cannot fetch its own skill before it runs; everything ELSE the architecture consists of — the norms, the other skills, the agents, the hook — is fetched at adopt time and is deliberately not vendored here. `ref` is what `sync.sh` pulls from and what `.github/workflows/validate.yml` compares against, so a copy that drifts from its source fails CI instead of shipping.
